title: Alert
description: Alert schema from Varonis DatAlert API

name.description: Name of the alert, typically derived from the threat model.

time.description: Timestamp when the alert was triggered.

category.description: MITRE ATT&CK-aligned category of the alert.

closeReason.description: Reason for closing the alert, populated only when status is Closed.

country.description: Country associated with the alert activity.

state.description: State or region associated with the alert activity.

userName.description: Name of the user whose activity triggered the alert.

userAccountType.description: Type of user account such as service account, admin, or regular user.

userDepartment.description: Department of the user whose activity triggered the alert.

deviceName.description: Name of the device involved in the alert.

isMaliciousIP.description: Indicates whether the IP address associated with the alert is known to be malicious.

assetPath.description: File system or resource path of the affected asset.

platform.description: Platform or data source where the alert was generated.

eventCount.description: Number of events associated with the alert.

isFlagged.description: Whether the alert has been flagged for special attention.

containsSensitiveData.description: Whether the affected resource contains classified sensitive data.
